items.headline: Manchester United draw with PSG in pre-season friendly
items.summary: United drew 1-1 with Paris Saint-Germain in a pre-season friendly in Gothenburg. Manager Michael Carrick identified good signs despite the result.

items.headline: Youri Tielemans makes first Manchester United appearance
items.summary: Summer signing Youri Tielemans made his debut for Manchester United after being signed from Aston Villa via release clause on a five-year contract.

items.headline: Andrey Santos confident of Casemiro replacement role
items.summary: Summer signing Andrey Santos, who joined from Chelsea for £48m, expressed confidence in stepping into Casemiro's number six role at Manchester United.
